budget_correction.reason: Prevent early lane-set members from exhausting the aggregate and silently starving later explicit lanes.

verification.selector: Exact cross-lane determinism, typed relations/conflicts, authority, budgets, schema parity, and immutable-PV integration
Lane guidance, reader, lane contract, registry, and packaged-skill integration
Python lint, compile, schema parse, and whitespace validation
verification.result: Ruff, py_compile, json.tool, and git diff --check passed

negative_cases: A cross-lane query cannot infer or discover its lane set; two to eight unique canonical lanes are mandatory.
Lane-local BM25 or TF-IDF scores cannot be compared as one cross-lane score.
Fuzzy or semantic joins cannot masquerade as exact typed evidence relations.
A result missing immutable project, PV, bundle, lane, source, chunk, path, locator, or parser provenance fails closed.
A per-lane result budget whose product exceeds 200, or an aggregate cap smaller than that product, fails closed before fan-out.
Conflict synthesis cannot hide conflicting immutable chunk identities and cannot produce a free-form model claim.
No lane SQLite, PV package, Plan backlog, raw FTS corpus, or lineage database is placed in model context.
limitations: Row217 supplies the internal typed cross-lane query primitive; explicit cross-project authority sets remain Row218.
Public skill and MCP routing remains Row221.
The separate Plan projection regression for historical TASK_CONTRACT_AMENDED self-status events is outside Row217 and was not edited here.
